title: Readers
body:
The readers sit in perfect silence.
[[1  SCREAM IN THE LIBRARY|Shout]]
[[2  Speak normally|SpeakNormally]]
[[3  Leave them alone|LeaveReaders]]

title: Shout
body:
HANA: HELLLOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!!! 
LIBRARIAN: A little quieter, please. Thank you, and enjoy your visit!

title: SpeakNormally
body:
HANA: Where is the computer terminal? 
LIBRARIAN: It's just at the end of the hall. Have a lovely day.

title: Crowd
body:
READER: Are you alright?
HANA: I need to get out...
READER: Please, go ahead.
